content.comment_body: Hello, can anyone explain how to change the time or pulse duration in [product_name] using the cursor keys? Or is it only possible to update counter values? ([company_name] [product_name] [article_no])
You can adjust a timer’s value with the cursor keys in two different ways. Also, could you clarify your question about only being able to change counters?
I was able to change the counter with the cursor key, but I couldn’t manage it with timers or pulse generators. Could you please provide an example showing both methods?
Please review the example I attached.

Thanks for your help. However, I still don’t see how to change the timer value. In my project, I have two timers (on/off) and want to adjust their values with the cursor key and monitor the values on a sub-screen. Alternatively, could I use a pulse generator and modify the pulse duration from the sub-screen?

Are you unable to substitute the two digital inputs (I1 and I2) with cursor keys in your program, or is there another issue? If you use cursor keys, you also need to press the ESC key to execute the change—so ESC plus a cursor key. Did the second example help? If not, I may not be the right person to assist you.

Sorry, I’m new to [company_name] products and didn’t fully grasp everything before. After working on it and checking your example, it works perfectly. I didn’t understand the timer part initially, but now everything is clear. Thank you for your assistance.

analysis.insight_summary: Initially, the user had difficulty adjusting timer and pulse generator values directly with cursor keys on the [product_name]. Counters were easier to change, but timers and pulse generators were less intuitive. The issue was resolved after the user consulted an example provided by another member, highlighting that clearer instructions for modifying timers via the hardware interface could be useful.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants the ability to modify timer and pulse generator values with the device’s cursor keys in the same way as counters, and be able to monitor these values on a subscreen.
pain_keywords: difficulty using cursor keys with timers
